claims.head: Something has to give
claims.body: The Penguins are one of the league’s best for chance quality, and the Blue Jackets are near the top of the league at preventing dangerous shots. Our lean: the Penguins’ chance quality wins out.
claims.call: The Penguins’ chances are more dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot) against the Blue Jackets.
claims.nums: Pittsburgh 3rd for chance quality (a 6.8% chance of scoring on the average shot) · Columbus 8th for preventing dangerous shots
claims.gist: It’s strength against strength: the Penguins for chance quality, the Blue Jackets at preventing dangerous shots.

check.measure: the average shot’s chance of going in, by expected goals
check.rule: held if tonight's figure lands on the predicted side of the league average; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: The Penguins kill penalties far better than the Blue Jackets
claims.body: On the penalty kill, Pittsburgh is near the top of the league and Columbus is one of the league’s worst. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.gist: The Penguins and the Blue Jackets sit at opposite ends for penalty kill.
claims.call: The Penguins’ penalty kill allows less per 60 than the Blue Jackets’.

CBJ.head: A slightly uphill night for Columbus
CBJ.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Columbus has home ice. Columbus can tip it if they get good looks.

PIT.head: Leaning Pittsburgh’s way
PIT.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Columbus has home ice. Columbus can still swing it if they get good looks.
